posts.author: Zia_
posts.body:
When you say "cutscene" ... Do your monsters have specific positions to spawn? Since cutscenes are usually fully scripted.
If so, you don't need any event spawner plugins.
Just place your monster NPCs where they are supposed to spawn, and set a switch as an event condition. Activate the switch to make them show up.
I can't really tell what's going on on your screenshots. For Galvs Event Spawner you set up a map to place all the events you want to spawn on other maps. Currently you selected map ID 4 as the source of your events.

posts.author: Neal_Sage
posts.body:
So... No need to use anything? OH yeah... I could just use an event with a condition? Oh yeah... why didn't I think of that... silly me. But what if I want to make a cutscene start when the player reaches a certain place, say a sidewalk and it triggers more than 1 event. So if the player triggers one of the events on the sidewalk, the cutscene starts and 3 enemies spawn around the player in certain coordinates, say 3 blocks ahead.
How do I do that?

posts.author: Zia_
posts.body:
You can use different switches for every event to show up one by one.
And if the first one doesn't show up at a specific position (like, always in front of the player, and you don't know where he will enter the sidewalk), you can load the current x and y position of the player into variables, modify them (e.g. x-1, if you want the event to show up one tile to the left of the player). And use "Set Event Location" to move the event to the new location before activating the switch.
